set -euo pipefail
compare_success() {
  local expected actual
  expected="'$(mktemp)
  actual=$(mktemp)
  /workspace/dataset/test12_executable "$@" >"$expected" 2>&1
  node /output/test12.mjs "$@" >"$actual" 2>&1
  cmp -s "$expected" "$actual"
}
compare_cli() {
  local expected actual exp_status act_status
  expected=$(mktemp)
  actual=$(mktemp)
  set +e
  /workspace/dataset/test12_executable "$@" >"$expected" 2>&1
  exp_status=$?
  node /output/test12.mjs "$@" >"$actual" 2>&1
  act_status=$?
  set -e
  perl -0pi -e "s/test12_executable/test12.mjs/g" "$expected"
  test "$exp_status" -eq "$act_status"
  cmp -s "$expected" "$actual"
}

printf "verification ok'"\\n\"
